Author: Bastaklis
Name: Presetway
Description: Reads the current zone, weather, and time of day and publishes them over a Sharingway IPC channel so a companion ReShade addon can switch presets automatically. Use /presetway to open the window, /presetway status for a text summary, /presetway config for settings.
Punchline: Automatically switches ReShade presets based on zone, weather, and time of day.
